bundle_format.columns: sym u2 (index into header symbols), date u2 (days since 1970-01-01), open/high/low/close/vol f4
bundle_format.header: JSON: symbols, starts, counts, dtypes, first_session, last_session, offsets
bundle_format.payload: format 2 gzip-compresses the column block, header stays raw
bundle_format.preamble: <8sIIQ: magic SLTPFLAT, format, header bytes, rows (24 bytes)

columns.Amount: split ratio (Kind 0; e.g. 7.0 is 7-for-1, 0.1 is 1-for-10 reverse) or cash per share in dollars (Kind 1)

columns.Bars: rows stored in the bar bundles, 0 until downloaded
columns.Country: country of headquarters, not of listing
columns.Currency: quote currency of the bars as Yahoo returns it, GBp for London pence
columns.CurrencyCode: ISO 4217 code of Currency, GBP when Currency is GBp
columns.Delisted: true when the listing is gone; delisted bars belong to the paid tier
columns.FirstBar: first session on disk, blank until downloaded
columns.FloatShares: free float, blank outside the US
columns.FundCategory: ETF mandate, e.g. Equity: US Large Cap
columns.FundFamily: ETF issuer or sponsor, ETFs only
columns.LastBar: last session on disk, blank until downloaded
columns.ListingDate: first listing date, YYYY-MM-DD, blank when unknown
columns.MIC: ISO 10383 venue the row is listed on
columns.Market: US, India, Canada, Japan, United Kingdom, France, Switzerland, Germany, Australia, Netherlands, Sweden, Italy, Hong Kong, Singapore
columns.MarketCap: market capitalisation in USD, blank outside the US
columns.MarketCapTier: Mega | Large | Mid | Small | Micro | Nano Cap
columns.Name: issuer or fund name
columns.PriceDivisor: divide stored prices by this for major units: 100 for GBp, else 1
columns.PriceHint: decimal places to show: 0 for JPY, 2 otherwise
columns.SharesOut: shares outstanding, blank outside the US
columns.Status: active | lagging | missing; missing marks a symbol waiting for its first download
columns.Symbol: our ticker and bar key, exchange-suffixed outside the US (BRK.A, 7203.T, BP.L)
columns.YahooSymbol: ticker yf.download expects; spelled differently for class and preferred shares (BRK-A, FITB-PI)

symbol_catalog.rows: one row per downloadable symbol: every symbol we hold bars for plus the download queue

layout.MARKET_DATA/DAILY/INTERNATIONAL/<year>.b: all 14 international markets in one bundle per year
layout.MARKET_DATA/DAILY/US/<year>.bin: US daily bars, one bundle per calendar year
layout.MARKET_DATA/DAILY/US/recent.bin: US tail since the last yearly close
layout.MARKET_DATA/symbol_catalog.parquet: download registry, one row per symbol
